name: AXM Deterministic PR Checkpoint
actions: inspect one clean local review branch without fetching or writing
bind base head tree commits changed blobs policy and declared evidence into one deterministic digest
hold mixed scope drift credentials sensitive content deletions renames and missing required evidence
verify a saved checkpoint without trusting its claimed digest
render a bounded deterministic draft review packet
summary: Create a path-independent, evidence-bound review checkpoint for an ordinary AXM branch before any push or pull-request action.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL review support. READY means the exact local Git objects satisfy the declared policy. It does not prove a remote is current, execute tests, create a PR, merge, promote, or change CANON.
